h2: Regular Pool Service Canggu – Weekly Care for Your Villa
intro: Canggu grew fast from rice paddies into villa-lined streets, and almost every rental here has a pool that needs consistent attention. A scheduled Regular Pool Service Canggu keeps your water balanced through daily leaf fall, guest use and the wet season. We cover Berawa, Batu Bolong and Pererenan, sending a WhatsApp photo report after each visit so you can track conditions without being on site.

sections.h3: Why Pools in Canggu Need More Than Occasional Cleaning
sections.text: Villas here went up quickly on former paddy land, which means a high water table and soil that shifts with heavy rain. In Berawa and Echo Beach, pools collect leaves from surrounding greenery almost daily, and the fast construction pace sometimes leaves loose fittings or poorly sloped drains that only reveal themselves after a few wet months. A steady service catches these small issues before they turn into costly repairs.

sections.h3: What Happens During Each Scheduled Visit
sections.text: Every session follows the same checklist so nothing slips: we test and balance chlorine, pH and alkalinity; vacuum the floor, brush the walls and clear the skimmer basket; then inspect the pump, filter and visible plumbing for early wear. Afterward you receive a short WhatsApp message with photos of the pool, your water readings and a note on anything adjusted. If something needs follow-up, it gets flagged right there in that report.

sections.h3: How to Book and What to Send Us
sections.text: To get started, send a few photos of your pool area on WhatsApp – the water surface, the pump room, any spots that look off or have been leaking. Tell us your preferred days and roughly how many guests use the pool weekly. We'll confirm a schedule and walk you through what each visit covers. Pricing depends on pool size and condition; once we see those photos we can give you a clear quote over the same chat.

sections.h3: Prevention Tips Before the Rainy Season Peaks
sections.text: Before the wet season hits, ask for an extra check on pump-room drainage, the overflow channel and any external plumbing near the garden. In Padonan and Babakan, streets flood quickly and standing water can back up into low-lying pump areas. Keeping the skimmer clean and the filter cycling properly during dry months means less strain when rains arrive, and a small monthly chemical top-up prevents the green algae bloom that catches most pools by October.

faq.q: How often does a pool in Canggu actually need servicing?
faq.a: Most villas benefit from weekly visits, especially around Berawa and Batu Bolong where leaf fall and guest turnover keep the water busy. If your pool is smaller or partially covered, fortnightly may work – send us photos and we'll suggest what fits.

faq.q: I'm only in Bali two months a year. Can you still manage my pool?
faq.a: Yes, that's exactly who this service is built for. You get a WhatsApp report after every visit with photos and readings, so you can monitor everything remotely without ever being on site.

faq.q: What should I include when I first message you on WhatsApp?
faq.a: A few clear photos of the pool surface, the pump area and any visible issues, plus your preferred days. That's enough for us to confirm a schedule and give you a quote based on what we see.
